descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Escape from X is in Early Access. We build it with our players, and your feedback shapes every update.

🔗 Join our community: discord.gg/Je33jR5nh
▶️ YouTube: @BadjoEntertainment

Escape from X – Skill Beats Gear
Every raid starts with a Glock. What you leave with is up to you. Escape from X is a skill-first VR extraction shooter built around real physical combat. You go from zero to hero on skill, not on a starting loadout.

NEW IN THIS UPDATE

🧠 Smarter NPC AI – Enemies take cover, flank, push and fall back. Trained on real playtest data.

🧭 Holographic indicators – See every action you can take, right where you take it.
[media]
🎯 Visual gun-handling tips – Reworked guides that teach new players fast.

🔫 Gun upgrades – All the weapon improvements from Escape from X: Shooting Range.

CORE FEATURES

💥 Real NPC body physics – Shove enemies, shoot their legs, and watch bodies react the way they should.
[media]
[media]
🎒 No floating menus – Everything is physical and in-hand, so you stay in the raid.
[media]
📸 Polaroid story clues – Piece together the story.
[media]
🗺️ Replayable maps – Learn gear routes and plan smarter runs every time.
[media]
[media]
[media]
🏆 Leaderboards – Compete in Treasure Hunter, Kill and Hardcore.

and more...
[media]
[media]

ON THE WAY

🐀 Groundwork laid for new enemies: The Hunter and The Rat

🤝 Co-op foundations are in, squad play is coming

💀 All About Shooting – Feel the chaos.

Welcome to ESCAPE FROM X.
